meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把旧版安装平滑升级到新版
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在把旧版迁移到新版
copy.tagline_en: Finish upgrading your old install to the new version
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're moving from an old version to a new one

howto.what: 此技能用于完成 NanoClaw v1→v2 的迁移收尾:它会读取交接文件,确认 v2 能正常收发消息,给主人账号授权,调整陌生人访问策略,从 v1 导入或迁移记忆与用户数据,并校验容器配置。整个过程不修改 v1 原始文件。
howto.when: 当你说出 “migrate from v1”、“finish migration”、“v1 migration” 等短语,或在 `bash migrate-v2.sh` 已完成后被调用时触发。

say.text: 帮我完成 v1 到 v2 的迁移收尾。
say.note: Claude 会读取迁移交接文件,处理尚未完成的步骤。

say.text: 迁移脚本已跑完,请继续处理 v1 迁移。
say.note: 对应技能入口,立即开始收尾流程。

say.text: 把 v1 里的旧联系人授权为 v2 用户。
say.note: 会让 Claude 导入并展示待确认的用户列表。

howto.what_en: Finishes a NanoClaw v1→v2 migration: reads handoff file, smoke-tests real messaging, grants owner role, sets sender policy, may import v1 users, migrates memory, checks container config, archives fork tweaks. Never modifies the v1 install.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "migrate from v1", "finish migration", or "v1 migration", or when it's invoked after `bash migrate-v2.sh` finishes.

say_en.text: Help me finish the v1 to v2 migration.
say_en.note: Reads handoff file and continues pending steps.

say_en.text: The migration script ran; please continue v1 migration.
Import my old v1 contacts into v2.
say_en.note: Triggers the import review and authorization flow.
